witness.implementation: gguf-py (the ggml project's reference Python reader)
witness.invocation: uv run --with gguf python scripts/gguf-crosscheck.py --facts gguf-qwen2.5-0.5b.json --model qwen2.5-0.5b-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf

notes: gguf-py reports 29 fields against the file's 26: the difference is ['GGUF.kv_count', 'GGUF.tensor_count', 'GGUF.version'], which it synthesises from the header. Subtracting them is the comparison, not a fudge.
